CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Winter-2019 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Winter-2019 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 713 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 3 benchmark sites in 3 regions spanning 3 states (survey period: June 2019 to July 2019). These surveys captured 4 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 7 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 587 cards across 52 sites, with 1% showing evidence of mouse activity (6 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 212 transects across 52 sites (survey period: June 2019 to July 2019), detecting active burrows in 1.4% of transects (total: 3 active burrows).
